༄༅/ /bshad pa'i rgyud khri drug stong pa'i dgongs pa rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i las byang bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i dbang ga

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bshad pa'i rgyud khri drug stong pa'i dgongs pa rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i las byang bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i dbang gi chu bo dngos grub kyi dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bshad pa'i rgyud khri drug stong pa'i dgongs pa rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i las byang bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i dbang gi chu bo dngos grub kyi dga' ston zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang 'jam mgon dpa' bo chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam dag gzod nas phung khams gdan gsum lha// glo bur nyes brgya'i dri mas sbags pa dag /rnam dag dbang gi chu bo 'di bab pas// bkrus nas bzod min lhan skyes gsal der 'dud// rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pas 'di yi bsnyen sgrub legs par thems nas/ slob ma mtshan ldan smin par bya ba ni/ gnas dus la sogs rgyud nas gsungs pa las byang du bshad pa lta bu'i dus la bab pa'i tshe lag tu blang ba la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po sngon 'gro la gnyis/ 'du bya ba dang*/ rnal 'byor bsgom pa'o// dang po 'du bya ba ni/ dkyil 'khor sna tshogs rdo rje phyogs mdog can gyi lte bar me ri'i nang du rdo ra/ de'i nang du dur khrod kyi bkod pa'i nang thod ra'i dbus su mu khyud dang bcas 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar rdo rje rgya gram nag po/ de'i lte bar rlung dkyil zla gam ljang gu'i dbus su nyi gdan la hūm̐ nag po/ rtsibs brgyad la hūm̐ re re dang*/ de'i 'og gi rtsibs kyi sa bon ni shar nub kyi rtsibs kyi mtshan ma'i rgyab tu hūm̐ re re rnams so so'i lha'i kha dog las byang ltar bri/ rnam rgyal bum par pad nyi chos 'byung gi lte bar hūm̐ dang las thams cad par pad nyi'i lte bar hūm̐ bri/ mgul chings kha rgyan dang ldan pa'i nang du lnga tshan bdun gyi rdzas rgyun 'bab kyi chu la sbyar bas sum gnyis bkang*/ rnam rgyal dkyil 'khor gyi mdun g.yon dang*/ las bum g.yas su+u bkod/ rnam rgyal gyi steng du dung zhal dri chus bkang ba'i steng du rdo rje la me tog gi phreng ba btags pa'ang bkod/

gzhan yang dbu rgyan rdor dril la sogs pa dbang gi rdzas rnams dang*/ sman raka gtor ma chu gnyis nyer spyod dang bcas pa g.yas skor du bshams/ thams cad kyang hrīḥṣ+ṭīs bsangs/ gtso bo'i sngags lan bdun bzlas la bzhag go// gnyis pa rnal 'byor bsgom pa la'ang gsum bdag mdun bum bskyed do// dang po bdag gi rnal 'byor ni/ skyabs sems nas rdzogs rim bar las byang ltar bya/ gnyis pa mdun bskyed sgrub pa'ang las byang las bshad pa ltar bsgrubs rjes/ bzlas pa bdag mdun thun mong du bya ba sogs kyang las byang dkyus ltar bya/ gsum pa bum pa bsgrub pa ni/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭīs bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ yig las// byung ba'i rin chen bum pa ni// mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs nang bcud kyis// gang ba gnyis las rnam rgyal dbus// dmar ser bh+rūṃ yig yongs gyur pa// gnam lcags mtshon cha'i 'khor lo'i dbus| |zhes pa nas/ bstan pa bshig rnams thal ba'i rdul du rlogs// zhes brjod pa'i bar las byang gi mdun bskyed ltar sbyar la/ bzlas pa ni/ bdag nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi// thugs srog hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas// bum nang gtso bo'i thugs ka ru// nyi steng hūm̐ la sngags bskor bar// phog pa thugs dam rgyud bskul zhing*// sa bon sngags dang sku las ni| |bdud rtsi bab pas lus gang bsam// sngags rnams gang 'grub ci 'grub bzla'o// de rjes las thams cad par/ pad nyi'i gdan la hūm̐ las rdo rje gtum po nag po phyag gnyis/ g.yas ral gri dang g.yon sdigs mdzub kyis zhags pa 'dzin cing zhabs g.yas bskum gyis bzhengs pa/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis med du bstim/ mchod cing bstod/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭī bi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang*/ oṃ ya ma badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces ci 'grub bzla'o// mthar bum pa gnyis la mchod cing bstod/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i lha rnams byang chub sems su zhu ba bum pa'i chur gyur/ las bum gyi lhas 'dir ji srid dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba ma rdzogs kyi bar du bgegs rnams zlog par mdzod cig /ces gsol/ skabs 'dir slob ma la dbang bskur ba ltar bdag 'jug blang*/ de'ang slob ma'i bya ba rang dang*/ slob dpon gyi bya ba dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos mdzad par bsam mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bzhi/ bum pa/ gsang ba/ shes rab/ tshig dbang ngo*// dang po bum dbang la gnyis/ thun mong ba dang*/ thun mong min pa'o// dang po thun mong ba rdo rje slob ma'i dbang ni/ slob ma rnams las thams cad pas khrus bya/ gral la 'khod/ bgegs bskrad maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dga' chen ston pa khyod gcig pu// slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po tshul gyi mchog /mgon po bdag la 'tshal lags so// dam tshig tshogs rnams bdag la stsol// thar pa'i grong du gzhug tu gsol// lan gsum/ yan lag bdun pa ni/ chos dbyings 'og min phyogs bcu'i zhing khams na// zhes pa nas/ bdag gis yang dag yongs su bsngo bar bgyi| |zhes pa'i bar las byang ltar lan gsum bya/ oṃ tsak+ṣurbahan+dhas gdong bcings/ a khaṃ bī ras me tog gtad/ gsang bar gdam pa ni/ 'di khyod dam tshig rdo rje ste// gal te khyod kyis 'ga' zhig la// 'di smras na ni mgo bo 'gas// zhes rdo rje mgor bzhag /slob ma'i snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pas mtshan par mos la/ slob mas/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ zhes sngags su sems bskyed/ brtan phyir rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa slob ma'i snying gar bzhag la/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/

zhes brjod dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje mgor bzhag nas/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs kun gyi// rigs su zhugs kyi khyod kyis ni// dkyil 'khor ma mthong ma dad la// tshul 'di smras na nyams par 'gyur// zhes rdo rje snying gar bzhag la/ rdo rje 'jigs byed deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// zhes dang*/ rnam rgyal steng gi dung zhal gyi dri chu dang a mṛ ta sbyar ba sbyin zhing*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub te// dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed// de bas rdo rje'i chu 'thung zhig /oṃ pañca a mṛ tod ka ṭha ṭha ṭhaḥ zhes sbyin/ rdo rje lag tu gtad nas/ khyod kyi rdo rje 'jigs byed nga yin pas// nga yis 'di gyis zhes ni gang bsgo ba| |khyod kyis bya dgos nga la brnyas mi bya// byas na ya nga ma spang bar 'phos nas// rdo rje dmyal ba la sogs khyod 'tshed do// zhes pa rnams kyis dam la bzhag /slob mas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni phyag 'tshal lo// gtso bo 'khor du bcas pa yi// lha rnams la yang phyag 'tshal lo// zhes phyag bya/ las kyi rdo rjes rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pas slob ma nang du khrid de/ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐/ zhes lha rnams dang skal mnyam byas par bsam/ slob mas/ sku gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// byang chub sems dpa' chen por bcas// dus 'di nas ni dgongs su gsol// bdag ni byang chub snying po la// nam zhig gnas kyi bar dag tu// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed bgyi// rang bzhin dag pa'i chos nyid de// dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid// stong nyid de bzhin nyid dbyings las// de bzhin rigs mchog sdom pa gzung*// 'dus ma byas pa'i byang chub sems// skye 'gag med pa'i rang bzhin gyis// dbyer med rnam rtog kun 'joms pa| |rdo rje rigs mchog sdom pa gzung*// mnyam pa nyid kyi rang bzhin la// yon tan thams cad lhun rdzogs pa'i// blang dor med pa'i byang chub sems// rin chen rigs mchog sdom pa gzung*// chos gang dri ma med pa'i ngang*// skyon gyis ma gos 'od gsal ba'i// rang gi mtshan nyid ma 'dres rdzogs// pad+ma'i rigs mchog sdom pa gzung*// bla med byang chub sems kyi mchog

/thugs rje thabs rol cir yang snang*// pha rol phyin sogs chos thams cad// las kyi rigs mchog sdom pa gzung*// mtha' yas sems can kun don phyir// byang chub mchog tu bdag sems bskyed// sdom pa ma lus gzung bar bgyi// ngan song bdag gis bsgral bar bgyi// 'khor ba bdag gis dgrol bar bgyi// rgyu yi sa las dbugs dbyung bgyi// sems can ma lus thams cad kun// bdag gis byang chub mchog la 'god// ces lan gsum gyis sdom pa gzung*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po bdag la dbab du gsol/ gsum gsol/ slob ma skad cig gis gsung rdo rjer gsal ba'i lte bar raṃ las me dkyil dmar po gru gsum pa yi ge raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ snying gar laṃ las sa dkyil ser po gru bzhi pa rdo rjes mtshan pa nyi ma la hūm̐ nag po/ mgrin par yaṃ las rlung dkyil nag po gzhu lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan par zla ba la āḥdamar po/ mgo bor baṃ las chu dkyil dkar po zlum po buṃ pas mtshan par ha dkar po rnams gsal ba/ snying ga'i hūm̐ las dri ma med pa'i 'od zer glog gi lcags kyu lta bu phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ rgyal ba rab 'byams rig ma dang bcas pa bkug te hūm̐ āḥha yig rnams la thim zhing*/ slar rkang pa'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung dkyil ljang khu gzhu lta bu'i steng du dzhaiḥdamar po gsal zhing 'bar/ me lce dang yaṃ las sbar ba'i rlung dang lhan cig pa'i me rlung drag po rkang pa'i bu ga nas myur bar zhugs pas lte ba'i me dkyil cher sbud pas de las rab tu 'bar ba'i me lces snying ga'i sa bsros pas lud drod kyi rang bzhin dang mgo bo'i chu bskol ba sa dkyil la bab pas bde ba'i rang bzhin dang*/ mgrin pa'i rlung dang 'dres pas bde drod dbyer med 'bar ba'i rkyen gyis rang sems yul snang thams cad bde stong du mer mer shig shig song bar bsam mo// sbyar ba'i spos bdug

/rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha rā dza bhai ra ba a dhi pa ti ā we sha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsa la ya tsa la ya/ to ṣa ya to ṣa ya hūm̐ āḥha dzhaiḥ zhes drag tu brjod pas ye shes dbab/ rdo rje rgya gram dang tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brtan par bya/ me tog thogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra maṇ+ḍal pa ti ma hā kro dha badz+ra bhai ra ba a dhi pa ti grā ma ṇaṃ puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha pū dza hoḥ zhes dor bas rigs brtag /de nyid/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa s+t+waṃ i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ zhes slob ma'i mgo bor bcings/ gser gyi thur ma thogs nas/ oṃ/ dpal chen rdo rje 'jigs chen pos// khyod kyi mig ni 'byed par mdzad// phye bas chos kun mthong gyur pa// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ zhes mig 'byed/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum du mthong bar bsam/ dbang bskur ba ni/ byang chub rdo rjes gsol ba btab/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i gdan la bum chu dang slob ma'i rnam shes kyi phung po hūm̐ dang rdo rje las zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed nag po g.yas rdo rje/ dbu rgyan dang slob ma'i tshor ba'i phung po aṃ dang rin po che las nga rgyal gshin rje'i gshed g.yas rin po che/ rdo rje dang slob ma'i 'du shes kyi phung po hrīḥdang pad+ma las 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed dmar po g.yas pad+ma/ dril bu dang slob ma'i 'du byed kyi phung po khaṃ dang ral gri las phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed ljang gu g.yas ral gri/ rdor dril dang slob ma'i gzugs phung buṃ dang 'khor lo las gti mug gshin rje'i gshed g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon de dag gi yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ dur khrod kyi chas dang dpal gyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan cing g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis bsgyings pa'i pang du rang 'dra'i yum gyis 'khyud pa'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i 'od kyis rang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/

nyer spyod lngas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa rnams la ye shes pa rnams thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang lha nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang lhas bum pa bdud rtsi'i gang ba bsnams nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma las rang rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rnams dbang rdzas kyi lha rnams la thim zhing*/ dbang rdzas slar bskyed pas yab yum snyoms 'jug gi bde bas zhu ba dbang rdzas so so'i rnam par gyur/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa dbang gi lha gdan gsum tshang ba'i rnam par mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba skyob pa'i khyad du dbang*// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar bstsal// de ltar 'di la'ang bstsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba slob dpon gyis btab la/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor pa'i gtso bos dbang gi dgongs pa mdzad/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang rdzas rnams rim pa bzhin du bsnams nas slob ma la dbang bskur/ yum rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis shis pa brjod cing me tog gi char 'bebs/ sems ma rnams kyis slob ma'i steng phyogs su gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan la sogs pa 'dzin cing glu dang gar mdzad/ khro bo dang khro mo rnams kyis phyogs mtshams srung zhing bgegs skrod bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ til gyi gang bu ltar gang ba'i// rgyal bas bum pa sogs bsnams pas// de ring khyod la dbang bskur bgyi// de ltar shes na yid bder byos// zhes spro ba bskyed pa dang bcas pas bum pa thogs nas/ dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje che// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i gsang ba gsum byung ba// sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya// oṃ badz+ra bhai ra ba badz+rod ka a bhi ṣiñca mi/

zhes dbang bskur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐ gis bum chu sbyin/ chu lhag ma las dpral ba'i steng du mi bskyod pas rgyas btab/ dbu rgyan ni/ rdo rje rin chen dbang bskur bas// ral pa'i thor tshugs rab brjid pa// dar dpyangs cod pan gyi ni dbang*// de ring khyod la sbyin par bya// oṃ āḥbadz+ra mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes mgor bcing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhis chu dbang sbyin/ chu lhag ma las rna ltag g.yas su rin 'byung gis rgyas btab/ rdo rje ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje yi// dbang gis de ring khyod dbang bskur// 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rab tu grub phyir rdo rje zung*// oṃ āḥbadz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ gis rdo rje gnas gsum du gtug cing lag g.yas su byin la/ des smin mtshams su gsor/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhis chu dbang sbyin/ chu lhag ma las ltag par 'od dpag med kyis rgyas btab/ dril bu ni/ oṃ/ dril bu rdo rje dang ldan pa// shin tu dpa' bo nyid dbang bskur// rdo rje'i dam tshig gnas pa khyod// bdag po'i dbang bskur rgyal nos shig /oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti twaṃ/ a bhi ṣiñca mi/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes mgor sbyin lag g.yon du gtad/ des smin mtshams su dkrol zhing dku g.yon du bzung*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhis chu dbang sbyin/ chu lhag ma las rna ltag g.yon du don grub kyis rgyas btab/ rdor dril ni/ rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas// rtag pa'i rdo rje rab bzhugs te// mi shigs rdo rje'i ming ldan par// bu khyod de ring dbang bskur ro// oṃ badz+ra satwa twaṃ a bhi ṣiñca badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal gsang mtshan btags/ zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// zhes mgor bzhag /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhis chu dbang sbyin/ chu lhag ma las mtshog mar rnam snang gis rgyas btab/

slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang lha rnams slob ma'i ba spu'i bu gar bstim/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de dag gi mtha' rten rdo rje'i brtul zhugs ni/ slob ma pad nyi'i gdan la hūm̐ las rdo rje 'chang gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog dkar po g.yas rdo rje g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis bsgyings pa rgyan dang ldan par bskyed/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad nyid// rdo rje sems dpa' phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ra yā mi badz+ra sarba hiḥhi hi hi hi hūm̐/ rdo rje rtse lnga lag tu gtad/ des kyang sngags de brjod cing smin mtshams su gsor zhing snying gar bzung*/ des ma rig pa'i gnyen po nus pa nyid du sgrub par byed pa rig pa'i dbang lnga thob pa yin no// gnyis pa thun mong min pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang*// mgon po bdag la deng stsol cig /'khor lo lha yi de nyid dang*// slob dpon phrin las yongs su bsngo// sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*// sdom pa'ang bdag la bstsal du gsol// zhes gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob ma dbang stegs seṅge la sogs pa'i khrir bzhag /pad nyi'i gdan la hūm̐ dang rdo rje las slob ma rdo rje 'chang 'jigs byed chen po sku mdog nag po rdor dril 'dzin pa/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang dur khrod kyi chas dang ldan par bskyed/ rdo rje hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' de zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o// zhes lag g.yas su gtad/ des kyang*/

oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes smin mtshams su gsor zhing snying gar bzung*/ dril bu aḥlas rdo rje snyems ma de zhu ba las byung ba'i dril bur gyur/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed// ces lag g.yon du sbyin/ des/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa hoḥ zhes brjod cing smin mtshams su dkrol nas dku g.yon par bzung*/ slob dpon gyis/ yid kyi lus ni brtan pa nyid// phyag rgya dam tshig rab tu brjod// gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan// des na phyag rgyar rab tu grags// zhes brjod/ slob ma lhar gsal ba'i pang du dngos sam yid kyi rig ma rdo rje ro langs ma gsal ba'i yab kyi gsang ba hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po rtse gcig pa nor bur oṃ dang bu gar phaṭa kyis bkag pa/ yum gyi mkha' pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa ze'u 'brur āḥdang rtsa rtser hrīḥs mtshan pa la 'khyud cing rlung kha sbyor gyi reg bde nyams su myong bar bsam/ slob dpon gyis/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la// lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud// rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba// slob dpon gyi ni dbang du 'dod// ces ngo sprad/ brtan phyir/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa dbang gi lha gdan gsum tshang ba'i zhes pa nas/ spro ba bskyed pa dang bcas zhes pa'i bar rig dbang gi skabs ltar la/ dbang rdzas rnams rim bzhin du bsnams nas kyi mal du/ bum pa dkar po byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba cung zad yo bar bsnams nas/ zhes bsgyur la/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// skye bas thob pa dbang bskur ba// ji ltar de bzhin bdag gis deng*// dag pa lha yi chu dbang bskur// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/

sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma las rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rnams slob ma la thim/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes me tog 'thor/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ e ma ye shes rang 'od me ri 'bar// zhes pa nas/ 'khor lo rgyal po yun du gnas/ zhes pa'i bar las byang ltar dag pa brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyis/ rdo rje che dang dril bu ni// che dag zung zhig deng byin brlabs// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma bsdu ba nyid du gyis// drag po'i las kyi sgrub pa dang*// drag po'i sbyor ba bsad pa yin// rab tu sbyor dang dbang du bsdu// 'gugs dang thams cad rgyas pa dang*// zhi dang dbye dang bskrad pa dang*// rab sbyor man ngag 'khrul 'khor dang*// gnad dgug drag sngags dag dang gzhan// man ngag gi ni gnas bdun dang*// man ngag gi ni rim pa dang*// sbyor ba rnam pa sna tshogs dang*// rten 'brel yid bzhin dag dang ni// log gnon drag po la sogs pa// rab 'byams las kun sgrub par gyis// dbang bskur ba dang sbyin sreg dang*// rab tu gnas la sogs pa'i rim// slob dpon las yin 'bad de sgrubs// zhes gnang ba sbyin/ sngags gtad pa ni/ slob dpon lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sngags phreng zhal nas thon/ slob ma lhar gsal ba'i rna ba g.yas nas zhugs te snying gar gnas par bsams pas/ drug pa gnyis dang*/ bdun pa/ bcu pa/ bcu bdun pa/ so gnyis pa rnams kyi rjes zlos lan gsum gsum gyi mthar| bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol// bla mas/ bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// phrin las rdzogs par mdzad du gsol// zhes dang*/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha me tog 'thor/ de'i mtha' rten ni/ sngags gang rung lan gsum bzlas pa'i thor tshugs thogs nas/

gshin rje'i gshed po'i phyag rgya ni// phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas// gzugs ni thor tshugs dbu rgyan nyid// byin pa dpa' bos bzung bar gyis// zhes mgo la bskon| der rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor mthong*/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus rtsa'i dri ma dag /bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ sprul pa'i sku'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /'bras bu sku rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so// zhes go ba sbyin/ gtang rag 'bul/ gnyis pa gsang dbang la maṇ+ḍal phul/ khyod kyi zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis// bdag gis bla med bya ba thob// de phyir gsang ba'i dbang gi ni// mgon pos rjes su gzung du gsol// gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ gdong bcings/ slob dpon rdo rje 'jigs byed dang*/ rig ma rdo rje ro langs mar gsal ba'i mkha' gsang byin brlabs/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i gsang rdzas mtheb srin gyis slob ma'i khar sbyin zhing*/ btung ba rin chen 'di yis ni// rdo rje yi ni lus grub par// bu khyod kyis ni shes gyis la// yid las byung ba'i chu 'thung zhig /ces dang*/ hrīḥṣ+ṭī brjod la sbyin/ des kyang btung ste/ a hoḥm hā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod gdong bsal/ yum gyi bha ga la bltar bcug /mtha' rten lung bstan pa ni/ slob dpon sprul sku'i cha lugs kyis g.yas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon snam sbyar gyi grwa gnyis snying gar bzung nas/ oṃ/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir// srid dang ngan 'gro rnams las bton// kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa sid+dhi sa ma ya bhurbahu waḥswaḥ gang yang lung bstan pa 'di la phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas kyang mgrin gcig tu lung ston par mdzad par nges la/ de ni sngags dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no// zhes brjod/ des gsang ba'i dbang thob/

bha ga'i dkyil 'khor mthong*/ ngag rlung gi dri ma dag /steng sgo rnam par grol ba'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /'bras bu gsung rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so// gtang rag 'bul/ gsum pa sher dbang la maṇ+ḍal phul/ bcom ldan zhi ba dga' chen po// rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa// rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung*// ji ltar khyod bzhin bdag kyang mdzod// gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ gdong bcings/ rig ma gtad la/ bud med gzugs dang mdangs bzang ma// shes rab bcu drug lon pa la// byin gyis brlabs te gnas gsum du// dben par mchod pa rab tu brtsam// lha mo dga' sbyin gnas sbyin ma// sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che// khyer la mchod pa rtag tu gyis// zhes gtad/ slob ma 'jigs byed yongs rdzogs bsam/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa dang*/ rig ma ro langs ma sngo bsangs gri thod 'dzin pa phyag rgya lngas brgyan par gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ las sku rdo rje/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje/ thugs kar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje/ mig tu k+ṣeṃ las sa snying*/ rna bar trāṃ las spyan ras gzigs/ snar hrīḥlas phyag rdor/ lce la dz+rīṃ las byams pa/ lus la me las sgrib sel/ yid la thaliṃ las kun bzang rnams gsal ba/ mkha' gsang gong ltar byin brlabs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes snyoms par zhugs pas byang sems dbab pa dga' bzhi lugs 'byung lugs ldog la bslab cing ngo sprad/ gdong bsal/ de'i mtha' rten dbugs dbyung ni/ 'di ltar yid ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du gyis// rang gi dam tshig mi zad bde gter brtan par gyis// 'gro ba bde ba gnyug ma rdo rje sems dpa' dang*// mtshungs pa'i rtag pa nyid du khyed rnams phyin par 'gyur// gzhan yang gang cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du dbang bskur ba la dge ba'i phyir sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis sdug pa'i bu dang 'dra ba thugs dang bas yang dag par dgongs par mdzad pa 'di ni chos nyid yin no// zhes brjod/

des shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor mthong*/ yid thig le'i dri ma dag /'og sgo bde ba chen po'i rigs bsgom pa la dbang*/ chos kyi sku'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /'bras bu thugs rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so// gtang rag 'bul| bzhi pa tshig dbang la maṇ+ḍal phul/ khyod zhabs pad+mo spangs nas ni// gtso bo gzhan na ma mchis pas// dpa' bo rdo rje slob dpon gyis// tshig gi dbang bskur bstsal du gsol// gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ gdong bcings ma bcing gang yang rung*/ slob dpon gyis/ dbang gsum pa'i dus kyi snyoms 'jug la brten pa'i dga' ba tha ma'i tshe nyams su myong ba'i ye shes de ni dpe'i ye shes kun rdzob pa yin la/ de'i rnam pa ltar la rnam kun mchog ldan lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba dang stong pa ro mnyam zung 'jug brjod dang bral zhing skye 'gag gnas gsum gyis ma bslad pa/ 'gyur bral 'pho med kyi bde chen rgyun mi 'chad pa rtag chad kyi mtha' spang ba'i dpa' bo chen po dang*/ rang bzhin 'od gsal stong pa nyid phyag rgya chen mo shes rab rtag mtha' spang ba'i yum dang*/ kha sbyor lhan skyes zung 'jug sgro skur gyi mtha' spangs pa rang rig pa'i ye shes 'di ni don dam pa'i bden pa chen po yin la de nyid rtogs pa'i thabs ni/ rnal 'byor rnam pa gsum sgom pa'i gnad kyis nyams su blang bar bya ba nyid do// zhes dang*/ gdong bcings pa bsal/ mtha' rten gzengs bstod pa ni/ slob dpon gyis/ khyod dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir zhugs mthong dbang bskur ba thob pas srid pa tha ma ba'i byang chub chen por gyur pa yin no// zhes brjod/ des dbang bzhi pa thob/ don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor mthong*/ sgo gsum der 'dzin dang yid thig le'i dri ma phra ba tshun chad dag /rnal 'byor rnam pa gsum gyi rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/

ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /'bras bu ye shes rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so// dam tshig bsdus te bsrung bar khas blangs/ gtang rag dang yon phul/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo la longs spyad cing lhag ma btang ngo*// gsum pa rjes ni/ thun mthar gtor ma btang ba nas bzung shis brjod kyi bar las byang ltar bya zhing las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// smras pa/ 'jam mgon chos dbyings gcig gi zlos gar las// sna tshogs gdul bya'i don du sgyu 'phrul rtsal// cho 'phrul ma he'i gdong pa can snang ba// dus mtha'i gdul bya 'dul ba 'di kho na// de yi dkyil 'khor 'jug cing dbang gi rim// rgyud don bsdus pa mdo ru dril ba 'di// thar 'dod slob ma'i re skong yid bzhin dbang*// gcig pur nges so ma skyur dga' bas longs// 'di dge zla gzhon ltar dkar bas// bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa// rdo rje 'chang dbang bhai ra ba'i// go 'phang mchog la rol gyur cig /bshad pa'i rgyud khri drug stong par gsungs pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i las byang*/ bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i dbang gi chu bo dngos grub kyi dga' ston zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ mched grogs dpal ri ba grags pa dbang po'i ngor/ 'bri gung pa skyu ra'i rigs las dus mtha'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa rim pa gnyis la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa rnam par dge ba'i blo can chos kyi grags pas/ me khyi snron gyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshes la pho brang rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu mgyogs par bris pa dge legs su gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ//
